sources.title: M-VAVE - Product Ecosystem
sources.excerpt: M-VAVE's official Product Ecosystem is the manufacturer's complete product lineup and includes its effect-pedal catalog. The exact model name DIST-MT1 appears in that manufacturer lineup, providing direct product-family identification for the named CUVAVE/M-VAVE distortion pedal.
